caption: A lit sparkler is dropped into a bucket of water, and it goes out with a hiss and a puff of steam.

sa.check: The sparkler is dropped into a bucket of water.
A puff of steam rises from the bucket.
The wire sinks dark in the water.
The drop comes first and the stopping follows.

pc.expect: The sparks stop as the sparkler enters the water and it does not keep sparking under the surface.
pc.fail: The sparkler keeps throwing sparks under the water; or the sparks stop before the sparkler reaches the water; or the sparks stop with the sparkler still held clear of the bucket; or the sparks start again while the sparkler is submerged.

pc.expect: The sparkler falls downward into the water and sinks or rests in it while the steam rises.
pc.fail: The sparkler rises out of the water with nothing lifting it; or the steam pours down the bucket's sides and pools; or the sparkler hangs in the air above the water; or the steam sinks below the bucket.

pc.expect: The burning only ends: the spent wire stays dark and the puff comes at the moment of entry and then eases.
pc.fail: The wire lights again under the water; or the dark wire turns back to fresh coating; or the steam bursts before the sparkler enters; or the puff grows steadily after the sparkler is in.

pc.expect: The water shows the sparkler arriving: it splashes and ripples where it lands and the steam rises from there.
pc.fail: The sparkler enters and the surface stays glassy; or the water ripples before the sparkler reaches it; or the steam rises from a part of the bucket the sparkler never entered.

pc.expect: One sparkler and one bucket; the wire goes into the water and stays there.
pc.fail: The sparkler vanishes in the water; or a second sparkler appears; or the wire passes through the bucket's wall; or the water's level jumps with nothing added.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The bucket, the water and the surroundings stay the same.
pc.fail: The bucket changes colour; or the water turns a colour; or items around the bucket rearrange.

note: The hiss is sound and is not judged.
